Reference

Glossary

The public term map for Plectis: every active vocabulary row is projected here as an expandable reader card, with its meaning namespace stated explicitly. General or domain usage, externally anchored terms, system-local specializations, system-coined terms, compatibility identifiers, and the project name are not treated as one ontology. These rows are generated from the governed system vocabulary registry.

How to read definitions. Outside explicit Plectis/ai_workflow context, ordinary, disciplinary, and externally owned meanings take precedence. A system-local specialization narrows an existing word only here; a system-coined term makes no claim to be generally accepted terminology. Repeated class-wide boundaries are explained here once; the cards below add only term-specific distinctions. In particular, a paper is the rendered PDF write-up for a project, question, or result, while a paper module is an internal subsystem-orientation packet, not a publication or proof.
Legacy name note. Microcosm is a compatibility identifier for Plectis, not a second product. Search this page for the card. It still appears in lineage, legacy URLs, old source paths, and migration records. For the rename and old-route behavior, read Lineage & legacy and the legacy route manifest.
plectisPlectispublic_projectionProject identityPlectis is the public name of this project: an open-source mathematics effort that publishes papers, Lean proofs, and software, with digestion and formal verification as the stated priorities.
componentcomponentpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA component is one bounded unit of machinery with a defined job, explicit inputs and outputs, and a limit on what it may claim.
scope_limitscope limitpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA scope limit is the explicit boundary between what a unit's evidence establishes and what that unit is not allowed to assert.
evidence_classevidence classevidenceSystem-coined termAn evidence class names the kind of support behind a result, without treating that support as proof of every claim drawn from it.
recordrecordartifactSystem-local specializationA record is a durable file or row you can reopen later to see what was checked, produced, or routed.
substratesubstratesubstrateSystem-local specializationA substrate is the underlying body of files, routes, recorded state, and tools that the system operates on, distinct from the pages and summaries projected over that source material.
source_authoritysource authoritygovernanceSystem-local specializationSource authority is the artifact, standard, tool, or ledger that owns a fact more strongly than anything generated from it: the source of record beneath any page, summary, or AI answer that merely reports it.
organorgan (source identifier)compatibility_identifierCompatibility identifierAn organ is the source-code name for the same bounded unit that public pages call a component.
witnesscheck resultevidenceSystem-local specializationA witness is the durable record that one specific check ran and what it found, shown in public copy as a check result or verification record.
navigablenavigablenavigationSystem-local specializationA navigable term, record, or page carries at least one concrete anchor, source reference, relationship link, command, or pointer that takes a reader from its summary to the underlying object or evidence.

locuslocuspublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA locus is a specific place where a feature, rule, effect, or piece of evidence resides or becomes observable.
machine_checkedmachine-checkedpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageMachine-checked means a result has been verified by software rather than accepted on a reader's judgement.
manifestmanifestpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA manifest is a structured inventory that lists the artifacts in a release or build together with the metadata needed to identify and check them.
mapmappublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA map here is a generated view over a body of material, built from that material rather than written alongside it, showing what is in it and how the parts connect.
mathematical_limitmathematical limitmathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA mathematical limit is the value a sequence or function gets arbitrarily close to as its index or input approaches a stated point or infinity.
mathematical_prioritymathematical prioritypublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageIn mathematics, priority is recognition of who found a result first, and asking for zero priority means the author does not claim that recognition for a result someone else solves.
mathematicianmathematicianpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA mathematician here is an invited reader and collaborator who can supply insight and direction on the public maths work, with credit kept for that contribution.
mathematicsmathematicssubjectGeneral or domain usageHere, mathematics means the published Erdős-problem work: definitions, proofs, computations, and papers on this site and in the Lean repository.
mathlibMathlibexternal_libraryExternally anchoredMathlib is the community-maintained mathematical library for Lean, providing reusable definitions, theorems, tactics, and notation.
mechanismmechanismdoctrineSystem-local specializationA mechanism is an account of how something in the system happens: how an object moves, transforms, routes, validates, or changes state, stated as the actual flow of inputs, steps, and outputs rather than as a label.
mechanism_contractmechanism contractpublic_projectionSystem-coined termA mechanism contract is the public component card's declared shape: what the component is for, which evidence class backs it, the source path, and where the claim stops.
mersenne_numberMersenne numberpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA Mersenne number is one less than a power of two: 1, 3, 7, 15, 31, and so on.
metabolismmetabolismruntimeSystem-local specializationMetabolism is the governed upkeep loop that refreshes derived artifacts from their authoritative sources and records the checks.
metadata_onlymetadata-onlypublic_projectionSystem-local specializationMetadata-only describes a record that carries the shape and verdict of a run but none of the content it read: counts, classes, digests and outcomes, without the bodies behind them.
microcosmMicrocosmcompatibility_identifierCompatibility identifierMicrocosm is the retired public name and continuing technical compatibility identifier for the source slice now presented to readers as Plectis.
miningminingpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationMining, here, is the continuous search for useful structure in a large space of AI reasoning, proofs, and drafts, analogously to how cryptocurrency mining searches a huge space of hashes.
modelmodelpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA model is a representation used to reason with: usually an AI system here, and with a qualifier a mathematical structure or a data schema.
modulemodulepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA module is a bounded unit of code or exposition grouped around one responsibility and designed to be referenced as a whole.
monicmonicpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA polynomial is monic when the coefficient of its highest power is 1, so it looks like zⁿ + lower terms rather than 3zⁿ + lower terms.
morse_saddleMorse saddlepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA saddle is a point where a surface rises in one direction and falls in another, like the middle of a mountain pass. It is a Morse saddle when the curvature there is non-degenerate, so the local picture is the standard one and the saddle is isolated.
multiplemultiplepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageMultiple can mean more than one item, or in arithmetic a number obtained by multiplying another number by an integer; Plectis uses both senses.
multiplicative_ordermultiplicative orderpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe multiplicative order of an integer b modulo Q is the smallest positive exponent k for which b^k leaves remainder one when divided by Q.
named_basisnamed basispublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA named basis is the exact bytes, rows, or inputs a claim is derived from, identified so an independent checker can recompute the verdict.
natural_numbernatural numbermathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA natural number is a whole number used for counting, with the convention about whether zero is included stated by the surrounding formalization.
navigationnavigationnavigationSystem-local specializationNavigation is the system’s browse-and-drilldown layer for moving from a question to the smallest source-backed answer surface.

open_obligationopen obligationpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationAn open obligation is the exact statement that would still have to be proved for a result to reach its target.

orbitorbitpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageAn orbit is the sequence of values produced by applying the same step over and over from a starting point.
orientationorientationpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageOrientation is the material meant to be read first: a short account of what this is and how to navigate it, as distinct from the evidence itself.
orphanorphanpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageAn orphan is an item an index has failed to place: something present in the source but connected to nothing in the map built over it.
packagepackagepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA package is a collection prepared to travel as one unit. In Plectis it can mean an installable software package or a submission or release package of artifacts.
packetpacketpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA packet is one JSON file that carries a structured copy of the public record, so it can be uploaded to an AI website in a single step instead of cloning a repository or scraping pages.
palomarPalomarpublic_projectionExternally anchoredPalomar is an external registry for machine-checked mathematical results, recording a repository at one fixed version, the formal statements claimed and the checks run.
paperpaperpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA paper is a rendered PDF write-up that gives a human-readable account of a project, question, method, result, and evidence boundary, linked to its supporting source where available.
paper_modulepaper moduleartifactSystem-coined termA paper module is a stable explanation packet mapping one subsystem's purpose, structure, invariants, source locations, and current state without replacing the code or records it describes.
partial_sumpartial sumpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA partial sum is the finite sum of the first selected terms of an infinite series.
passionpassionjudgment_traitSystem-local specializationPassion is the judgment trait that keeps the operator's live aim and stake present while the work remains bounded by standards, evidence, and source authority, preserving why the work matters as well as what it must complete.
path_handlepath handlenavigationSystem-coined termA path handle is a stable short identifier that resolves to a current file path, its role, and its verification command.
pdfPDFformatExternally anchoredPDF is a document file format designed to preserve a page's visual layout across devices and software.
peerpeeractorSystem-local specializationA peer is another capable coding-agent instance working on the system that can inherit durable lessons recorded by earlier agents, without implying shared memory or authority beyond those records.
peer_propagatepeer-propagatepropagationSystem-coined termA peer-propagate is a source-linked, reusable lesson in operating judgment that one capable agent records for future peer agents to inherit.
perfect_setperfect setpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA set is perfect when it is closed and has no isolated points, so every point in it is approached arbitrarily closely by other points of the set.
periodicperiodicpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA sequence is periodic when a fixed block repeats forever, and eventually periodic when such repetition begins after a finite initial segment.
phasephaseruntimeSystem-local specializationA phase is a scoped work packet inside a family of related work: a bounded unit of execution that holds one objective, the active wave of work, the references it draws on, and the state needed to pause and resume it later.
pippippublic_projectionExternally anchoredpip is Python's package installer, the command that fetches a project's dependencies and puts them where Python can find them.
planted_errorplanted errorpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA planted error is a fault introduced on purpose to check that a detector notices it.
planted_forgeryplanted forgerypublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA planted forgery is a deliberately false claim placed in a test input so that a check can be observed refusing it.
positive_integerpositive integermathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA positive integer is an integer greater than zero.
primeprimepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA prime is a whole number greater than one divisible only by itself and one.
prime_gapprime gappublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA prime gap is the difference between two consecutive prime numbers.
principleprincipledoctrineSystem-local specializationA principle is a durable operating law that constrains how agents and the system behave, stored as a numbered rule with a written rationale.
problem_noteproblem notepublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA problem note is a short standalone paper on a single open mathematical problem, stating what has been formally proved, what remains open, and where the boundary between them lies.
producerproducerpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA producer is the untrusted generator of a claim or certificate; acceptance must come from a separate small checker, not from the producer itself.
productproductpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageIn Plectis, product usually means a user-facing software offering or capability; in mathematical passages, a product is the result of multiplication.
profile_gapprofile gapnavigationSystem-coined termA profile gap is a recorded admission that an artifact kind exists but lacks the supported summary and card rows needed for honest row-by-row browsing, so navigation shows the gap instead of pretending the option surface is complete.
programprogrampublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageProgram can mean executable computer instructions or an organized initiative such as a bug-bounty program; Plectis uses both senses.
projectionprojectionpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA projection is a derived view generated from one or more source artifacts to make selected facts easier to read, query, or navigate without becoming their authority.
projection_driftprojection driftpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageProjection drift is what happens when a copy stops matching the source it was made from.
proofproofmathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA proof is a logically valid argument showing that a mathematical statement follows from stated definitions, assumptions, and previously established results.
proof_assistantproof assistantpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA proof assistant is a program that verifies mathematical proofs mechanically, requiring every step to be justified in a form it can check.

proof_checkerproof checkerpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA proof checker is the small trusted program that accepts a formal proof only when every encoded inference follows from the system's rules and stated assumptions.
propositionpropositionmathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA proposition is a declarative mathematical statement that has a definite truth value once its terms and assumptions are fixed.
provenanceprovenancepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageProvenance is the record of where something came from: which source a copied file was taken from, and whether it still matches.
pytestpytestpublic_projectionExternally anchoredpytest is the standard tool for running automated tests in Python projects.
queryablequeryablepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageQueryable means a reader or assistant can find the thing by asking or searching, without already knowing the path to it.
quickstartquickstartpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe quickstart is the shortest path from nothing to a first result: clone, install, run one check, read the file it wrote.
radixradixpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA radix is the base of a positional numeral system, so a radix-two expansion is binary and a radix-ten expansion is ordinary decimal.
rationalrationalpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA number is rational when it can be written as one whole number divided by another.
raw_seedraw seedsubstrateSystem-coined termA raw seed is the append-only, unedited record of the operator's own words and thinking, serving as the source layer from which later summaries, doctrine, and routes are derived.
readerreaderpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA reader is the person or software consumer trying to understand, navigate, or use a published artifact.
reader_packetreader packetartifactSystem-coined termA reader packet is a generated, portable guide that gathers routes, short summaries, source references, and scope limits so a person or AI assistant can inspect a public source slice without mistaking the guide for that source.
real_numberreal numbermathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA real number is a point on the continuous number line, including every rational and irrational number.
receiptreceiptpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA receipt is the durable output that proves an action happened: the file or record a step writes, kept so the claim can be checked later rather than taken on trust.
reciprocalreciprocalpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe reciprocal of a number is one divided by it.
recurrencerecurrencepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA recurrence is a rule defining each term of a sequence from the ones before it, rather than by a direct formula.
reductionreductionpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA reduction turns one problem into another, so that solving the second would solve the first.

registryregistrypublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA registry is a governed collection of uniquely identified records for one kind of object.

replayreplaypublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA replay is a check that re-runs a recorded scenario end to end and asserts the outcome, rather than testing a function in isolation.

reproduciblereproduciblepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageReproducible means another reader can use the declared source, inputs, environment, and command to obtain the same materially relevant result.
research_shiftresearch shiftpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA research shift is a bounded task a person gives their coding agent: start from one exact public revision, attempt a continuation on one problem, and return a checkable result.
result_recordresult recordpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA result record is the durable file a check writes with what it tested, what it found, and the boundary of that finding, as distinct from an ephemeral message shown while the run executes.
reviewer_briefreviewer briefpublic_projectionSystem-coined termThe reviewer brief is the small generated JSON packet a reader can hand the public site to an assistant in one turn.
rigidityrigiditypublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA rigidity result says that an object satisfying a few loose conditions is forced to be one specific thing.
routingroutingnavigationSystem-local specializationRouting is the path-selection step that maps a query, task, file path, or state to the smallest useful answer surface or owning work lane before source is opened.

rowabilityrowabilitynavigationSystem-coined termRowability means an artifact kind can be browsed as stable, source-linked rows instead of found by guessed keywords.
runrunpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA run is one execution of a program, command, test, experiment, or governed process.
runnablerunnablepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageRunnable means a component ships everything needed to execute it locally: the code, its inputs, and a command, so a reader can produce the result rather than read about it.
runtimeruntimepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA runtime is the code and execution context active while a program or workflow is actually running, as distinct from its source files and static descriptions.
schemaschemapublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA schema is a machine-readable contract describing which fields a structured record may or must contain, their types, and the constraints between them.
scopescopepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageScope is the declared set of objects, cases, operations, time, and conditions to which a statement, check, permission, or piece of work applies.
semantic_namingsemantic namingnavigationSystem-coined termSemantic naming makes an identifier reveal an artifact’s role, authority, lifecycle state, and route to detail.
sequencesequencepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA sequence is an ordered list of terms indexed by positions, usually the positive integers, so each position has a specified value.
seriesseriespublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageIn Plectis, series can mean an infinite mathematical sum or an ordered stream of data values; the two uses are distinct.
setsetmathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA set is a collection determined by which distinct elements belong to it, without treating order or repetition as part of its identity.
shared_pathshared pathpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe shared path is the sequence most components on this site follow: state a claim, run a check against fixtures, write a result record, and record the scope limit of what that establishes.
skillskillartifactSystem-local specializationA skill is a discoverable, reusable procedure that packages its invocation triggers, execution steps, constraints, and metadata so an agent does not have to reconstruct the workflow each time.
sliceslicepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA slice is a bounded cut through a larger system: the specific files, paths, or records a piece of work covers, named so that what is inside and outside the cut is explicit.
smoke_checksmoke checkpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA smoke check is a fast, shallow check that the basics work at all, run before anything more detailed is attempted.
smooth_numbersmooth numberpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA whole number is smooth relative to a set of primes when every prime that divides it lies in that set: equivalently, a y-smooth number has no prime factor larger than y.
softwaresoftwarepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageHere, software is the public Plectis repository of runnable research components, separate from the Lean mathematics repository.
sourcesourcepublic_projectionSystem-local specializationOn this site, source is the committed file or path a public claim names as the thing to open, as opposed to the generated page that displays it.
source_bodysource bodypublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA source body is the actual code of a function or module carried into a public bundle, as opposed to a description, signature, or hash of it.
source_filesource filepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA source file is the human-written file a program is actually built from, as opposed to anything generated, compiled or copied from it.
source_slicesource sliceartifactSystem-coined termA source slice is the deliberately selected, bounded set of source files published to back the hosted pages and reader packets, excluding the remainder of the working tree.
spanlinear spanpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe span of a collection is everything you can build from it by scaling its members and adding them together.
sparse_checkoutsparse checkoutpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA sparse checkout downloads only the parts of a repository you name, so a large repository can be used without fetching everything.
specificationspecificationpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA specification is an explicit description of required behaviour, structure, interface, or constraints against which an implementation can be judged.
squarefreesquarefreepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA whole number is squarefree when no prime divides it more than once, so it has no repeated prime factor.
standardstandardartifactSystem-local specializationA standard is a machine-readable contract fixing an artifact kind's required fields, authority, validation, and maintenance rules in a form that both people and agents can inspect and check.
statement_nodestatement nodepublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA statement node is one mathematically distinct statement in the map over a proof corpus, which several declarations may share if they establish the same thing in different form.
stationary_bootstrapstationary bootstrappublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe stationary bootstrap resamples a time series in randomly sized blocks, so the resampled series keeps the short-range dependence the original had.
stubstubpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA stub is a placeholder with the shape of the real thing but not its contents.
subsumsubsumpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA subsum of a series is the total you get by keeping some of its terms and discarding the rest.
sumsummathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA sum is a quantity formed by addition; Plectis distinguishes finite exact sums from infinite sums defined by limits.
superior_predictive_abilitysuperior predictive abilitypublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageHansen's superior predictive ability test asks whether any method in a whole set genuinely beats a benchmark, correcting for the fact that searching many methods will throw up a winner by luck alone.
supportsupportpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageOn Plectis, support can mean evidence backing a claim or, in the Erdős mathematics, the set of indices whose terms are included in a sum.
sylvester_sequenceSylvester's sequencepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageSylvester's sequence is 2, 3, 7, 43, 1807, and onward, where each term is the product of all earlier terms plus one.
synth_seedsynth seedartifactSystem-coined termA synth seed is the current phase brief: its goal, success conditions, relevant files, and next execution wave distilled from durable intent.
syntheticsyntheticpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageSynthetic means data made up for the purpose of a check, rather than taken from real use.
terminalterminalpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe terminal is the text interface where you type commands directly to your computer rather than clicking through a screen.
testtestpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationOn this site, a test is the procedure a component ships (usually pytest, sometimes Lean) that compares what happened with what the claim said should happen.
theoremtheorempublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA theorem is a mathematical statement together with a proof of it.
toolchaintoolchainpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA toolchain is the ordered set of compilers, interpreters, package managers, builders, and checkers used to turn source files into a runnable or verified result.
totienttotientpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe totient of a whole number is how many smaller positive numbers share no factor with it.
transcendentaltranscendentalpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA number is transcendental when no polynomial with whole-number coefficients has it as a root.
transcripttranscriptpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA transcript is the recorded text of a session, kept so what was said or done can be reread rather than recalled.
truth_maintenancetruth maintenancediagnosticSystem-coined termTruth maintenance is the bookkeeping that ties each belief to its evidence, dependencies, invalidation conditions, and consequences so failed assumptions or contradictions are routed to repair instead of silently corrupting settled state.
tryingtryingpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageTrying is attempting the work so that failure modes can be encountered; it is not a claim that the attempt succeeded.
type_aType AactorSystem-coined termA Type A is an actor with gated access to the live substrate, able to inspect current files and records, run tools, and perform mutations such as editing, validation, testing, committing, or routing work.
type_a_judgmentType A judgmentactorSystem-coined termType A judgment is a capable substrate actor's governed discernment for noticing what is missing, stale, or misplaced and inferring the right bounded destination from the system's own rules without waiting for a bespoke instruction.
type_a_metabolismType A metabolismruntimeSystem-coined termType A metabolism is the high-agency lane that resolves work with no settled rule (naming primitives, repairing contradictions, changing standards, or promoting principles) into governed structure that later routine work can follow.
type_a_operating_registerType A operating registeractorSystem-coined termThe Type A operating register is the expected conduct of a live-substrate agent: steward what it touches and durably route what it learns.
type_bType BactorSystem-coined termA Type B is an actor reasoning from context handed to it outside the live substrate, able to produce advice, drafts, or candidate answers but unable to inspect private files, run local commands, or mutate the system directly.
type_b_metabolismType B metabolismruntimeSystem-coined termType B metabolism is the bounded, deterministic upkeep lane for repeatable work after a structure is settled, such as syncing files, refreshing projections, filling records, and running checks rather than inventing new governing shapes.
typed_refusaltyped refusalpublic_projectionSystem-coined termA typed refusal is an explicit, reason-carrying no-result when a computation cannot honestly produce a value, instead of a plausible fake answer.
typed_relationtyped relationpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA typed relation is a recorded link between two statements that says what kind of link it is: that one implies another, reformulates it, is a finite instance of it, or rules out a route to it.
uninterpretableuninterpretablepublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageUninterpretable means a person cannot yet restate, situate, or explain the result, even if a machine has accepted a formal version of it.
unit_discunit discpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageThe open unit disc is the set of complex numbers whose distance from the origin is strictly less than 1, written |z| < 1.
up_propagateup-propagatepropagationSystem-coined termTo up-propagate is to move a reusable local lesson into the smallest durable system artifact that should carry it.
validatorvalidatorpublic_projectionGeneral or domain usageA validator is a program or component that applies declared rules to an input and emits a structured pass, fail, warning, or blocked result.
variablevariablemathematical_conceptGeneral or domain usageA variable is a named value that may vary or be supplied later; in Plectis it appears both as a mathematical symbol and as a program or configuration value.
vibe_mathingvibe-mathingpublic_projectionSystem-coined termVibe-mathing is doing mathematics with an AI by steering on intuition and conversation, letting the model supply the argument, and having no independent way to tell which steps hold.
wavewaveruntimeSystem-local specializationA wave is one bounded pass of execution inside a phase: a single planned unit of work with a stated objective, an execution mode, the paths it is allowed to touch, and a route for folding its outcome back into the system's durable record.
whisperWhisperpublic_projectionExternally anchoredWhisper is OpenAI's speech-to-text model, which turns recorded audio into text with timings for each word.
whole_system_correctnesswhole-system correctnesspublic_projectionSystem-local specializationWhole-system correctness is the claim that an entire system behaves correctly, used here mainly as an explicit boundary that no individual page, component, or passing check is allowed to assert.
work_landingwork landingpublic_projectionSystem-coined termWork landing is the transition from attempted activity to a durable accepted result whose changes, validation, ownership, and closeout are recorded.
working_recordworking recordpublic_projectionSystem-local specializationA working record is the long-form rendered PDF that preserves the reasoning surface for one Plectis mathematics problem.
workingnessworkingnessdiagnosticSystem-coined termWorkingness is whether the system knows what it believes, why, what it does not know, and what that uncertainty still permits, rather than a count of passing tests.
workingness_instrumentWorkingness InstrumentartifactSystem-coined termA workingness instrument is the record that states what one live result proves and which changes that evidence permits or blocks.
The glossary explains reader-facing words. It does not rename source paths, package ids, old URLs, compatibility handles, or authority records by itself.
